journeys.before: Home -> 'See Today's Picks' lands on /today (1 click + scroll). But the nav offers 'Market Center' (/markets) for the same concept and 'Today' for the same destination under a different name — three labels circle one job. A reader using the nav plausibly opens /markets first: +1 wrong turn.
journeys.failure: terminology split: Picks / Market Center / Today

journeys.before: Home -> Simulate -> game report. 2 clicks, clean. CTA labels on sport cards say only 'Enter ->'.
journeys.failure: bare-verb CTA labels ('Enter') on Simulation Hub cards

journeys.before: Home -> MLB (rail, desktop only; on mobile: Sports -> directory -> MLB) -> scroll to find picks section. Hub sections exist but in-hub wayfinding is scroll-only.
journeys.failure: mobile reaches a sport hub in 3 actions; hubs lack section navigation

journeys.task: Start from a suggested parlay and modify it
journeys.before: Home -> 'View Suggested Parlays' (/build). Ladder cards support leg SWAP only — there is no way to take a suggested card into the builder as an editable draft. Add-a-leg / remove-without-replacement dead-ends.
journeys.failure: suggested cards and custom construction do not share a draft: the charter's central P0

journeys.task: Build a custom card and find its later result
journeys.before: Home -> Build -> scroll past ladder + lanes to 'Advanced builder' (below fold, jargon name) -> add legs -> stake. No path from the builder to where a kept card's result would appear (/results/parlays not linked).
journeys.failure: builder buried below fold under internal vocabulary; no forward path to results

findings.finding: Suggested cards and custom construction coexist on one page but do not share a draft-card state. 'Start/Customize this card' does not exist; swap is the only edit. Two entry intents (browse vs build) are stacked vertically with no mode identity, no URL-stable mode, and the builder is titled 'Advanced builder' below the fold.
findings.test: e2e: a ladder card's Customize action lands in Build Your Own with the card's legs preloaded as an editable draft sharing stake/conflict/payout engine; mode survives refresh/share/back.

findings.finding: No 'Home' entry on any nav surface (logo-only). The six primary destinations do not match the reader's questions: 'Market Center' names the picks job with market jargon; 'Build' names the parlay job with a bare verb; hero CTA 'See Today's Picks' points at /today while the nav's picks-shaped item points at /markets.
findings.test: rendered-nav reconciliation: Home/Today/Simulate/Picks/Parlay Center/Results appear with identical labels+order on rail/top/mobile/footer; hero CTA labels agree with nav labels for the same destination.

findings.finding: Global top strip carries Paper record / Peak bankroll money chips linking to /mr-dub and /bank-builder — status acting as a second navigation, ahead of orientation. Charter: top bar = date/slate/freshness only.
findings.test: top strip renders date/slate/freshness only; record figures remain on /results and product pages (canonical owners).

findings.finding: 'View card · 0 legs' sticky pill renders with an empty selection and floats over the risk-ladder content — an affordance with nothing behind it, covering content the reader is trying to read.
findings.test: sticky slip summary appears only when >=1 leg is selected and never occludes filters or primary actions at 390px.

findings.finding: First viewport spends its budget on badges (3 pill rows) + a 4-chip status strip before any task action; on 390px the logo + chips consume the entire first screen. Primary tasks (Picks/Simulate/Parlays) are below badge noise; 'Results' proof link is not in the hero.
findings.test: at 390px the value sentence and the three primary actions render within the first viewport; Results visible as secondary proof link.
findings.resolvedBy: R-B (ea762aa9c) — verified at 390×812: headline 414px, all three actions in the first viewport

findings.finding: Hubs are scroll-only monoliths: no in-page section nav, sections differ by sport, sport capabilities are not one action from hub top.
findings.test: shared SportHubShell section nav at 4 widths; every available capability reachable in 1 action from its hub.

findings.finding: Internal vocabulary in public copy (artifact, optimizer, engine-gated, marketplace); 'Enter ->' / 'View' CTAs; per-page prose walls before state.
findings.test: copy audit: CTAs are action+destination; glossary owns terms; state before prose.
findings.backlog: P2 · owner: public pages; partial by R-D (destination labels unified; 'Enter' CTAs named); remaining: internal vocabulary sweep (optimizer/artifact/marketplace) — acceptance: copy audit finds zero internal terms outside expandable technical disclosures

journeysAfter.method: built link graph (out/) + in-browser walkthroughs at 390/768

results.after: Home -> 'See Today's Picks' opens /markets — the destination the nav labels 'Picks'. One label, one job, one click. Wrong-turn source removed (verified in the built graph).
Home -> 'Open MLB hub' (named CTA) -> game report. 2 clicks; no bare 'Enter' on the sport cards.

Mobile: Home -> Menu -> MLB (2 actions; was 3 via /sports directory). In-hub: the shared section nav puts every capability (board, sims, cards, Picks, Parlay Center, Results) one action from hub top (hub-shell guard).

Home -> 'Open Parlay Center' -> ladder card -> 'Customize this card' -> Build Your Own with the card's legs as an editable draft (browser-proven: 2 legs seeded, +235 price parity, refresh persists). Swap AND full add/remove now share one engine.
Home -> Parlay Center -> 'Build Your Own' tab (visible in the header, no scroll past the ladder) -> add legs -> stake. 'Every settled card (history)' links the record from the same page.
